title: Does CoT Faithfulness Really Collapse with Difficulty, or with Token Length?

original_idea.body: Jointly regress verbalization on difficulty and CoT length to disentangle the confound.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: disentangling difficulty vs length could yield a training-free lever to keep CoT monitorable on hard tasks.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: collect CoTs, joint regression, length-capping; regression analysis is intermediate.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused; requires assembling difficulty-labeled trials and regression, contained.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, open models, weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference + analysis on one open model; single GPU.
